clue.text: Slit left in window frame

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for left is placed inside the word for the frame

parts.note: a sash is the sliding frame of a sash window

explanation.surface: A gap on the left-hand side of a window's frame.
explanation.definitionFit: A slash is a long cut, the same as a slit or gash.

clue.text: The best person to get on to the Right

parts.note: the star is the best performer in a show
to board a ship or bus is to get on it

explanation.surface: The top candidate is chosen to join the political Right.
explanation.definitionFit: Starboard is the right-hand side of a ship facing forward.

clue.text: Proverbially a mile? Wrong

definitions.meaning: the proverb says a miss is as good as a mile

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb's near miss matches a mile, and the word also means faulty or out of order.

clue.text: A man, clumsy and callous

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
artless can mean crude or clumsy, without skill

explanation.surface: Description of a man who is awkward and unfeeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartless and callous both mean unfeeling, lacking compassion.

clue.text: Goliath's birthplace — note call for assembly

parts.note: Gath is the Philistine city the Bible names as the home of Goliath
E is one of the musical notes
to ring someone is to call them on the telephone

explanation.surface: A quiz question about where Goliath came from, followed by a summons to a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering is a meeting of people, an assembly.

clue.text: Distorted face of a mirthless champ

parts.note: grim means joyless or mirthless
an ace is an expert or champion

explanation.surface: The twisted expression of a champion who is not enjoying winning.
explanation.definitionFit: A grimace is a contorted expression of pain or disgust.

clue.text: Trace sign in a Chinese puzzle

parts.note: a tang is a slight trace or hint of a flavour
the Ram, Aries, is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Following a symbol through a puzzle from China.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangram is a Chinese dissection puzzle of seven pieces forming shapes.

clue.text: Turn up, point rod, and beat it.

indicators.note: turn up in a down clue means read upwards, so the word for rod is turned round

parts.note: a pole is a rod
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Instructions to arrive, aim a fishing rod and then run off.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run away secretly, and beat it is slang for leave quickly.

clue.text: One point to consider in travel .

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a tine is a prong or point, as on a fork
to rate something is to consider or regard it

explanation.surface: A single matter worth thinking about when taking a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: To itinerate is to journey from place to place.

clue.text: Big gun round about

indicators.note: round says the word for gun goes around the word for about

parts.note: gat is old slang for a gun
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A large firearm turned about.
explanation.definitionFit: Great means large in size.

clue.text: One maiden in a race shows, liveliness

indicators.note: in puts the one-plus-maiden pair inside the phrase for a race

parts.note: a nation is a people or race
I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A single girl taking part in a running race shows plenty of spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: IM goes inside A NATION, after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Animation is vivacity or spirit, the quality of being lively.

clue.text: No elasticity in an arch?

parts.note: O is zero, nothing, so it stands for no
give is the stretch or flexibility in a material

explanation.surface: An engineering question: does an arch have no flexibility in it?
explanation.definitionFit: An ogive is a pointed Gothic arch; the question mark shows it is one kind among many.

clue.text: Assail, .and defeat when out East. 5

indicators.note: out says the word for defeat sits outside the letter for East

parts.note: to best someone is to beat them

explanation.surface: Attack and beat an enemy while campaigning out in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: To beset is to attack from all sides, to assail.

clue.text: Soldiers get a salute all round for '1 the treaty

indicators.note: all round tells us the word for salute goes around the soldiers

parts.note: to greet someone is to salute or welcome them
men is a common crossword word for soldiers, the rank and file

explanation.surface: Troops are saluted on every side as a peace pact is signed.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal pact or accord between states.

clue.text: Become attached to a cold island'.

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
Crete is the large Greek island

explanation.surface: Someone grows fond of a chilly island.
explanation.definitionFit: To accrete is to grow together or stick on by accumulation, so to become attached.

clue.text: Calmness and quiet in the Italian lake, of course

indicators.note: in puts the letter for quiet inside the lake's name

parts.note: Como is a lake in northern Italy
P stands for piano, quiet in music
sure means of course, certainly

explanation.surface: Peace and quiet at an Italian lake, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Composure is calmness of mind, being unruffled.

clue.text: Blight unfortunately recurs in. the wine

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or blight

indicators.note: recurs is read as runs back, so the word for unfortunately is turned round

parts.note: alas is a cry meaning sadly or unfortunately

explanation.surface: A vineyard disease has sadly come back and spoiled the vintage.
explanation.definitionFit: Marsala is a fortified wine from Sicily.

clue.text: Note on allegory can be put right

parts.note: re is a note of the sol-fa scale
a parable is a story with a moral, an allegory

explanation.surface: A remark about an allegory that may be corrected.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reparable can be repaired or set right.

clue.text: London show of such self-confidence by Boucicault.

definitions.text: London show of such self-confidence by Boucicault

parts.words: London show of such self-confidence by Boucicault
parts.note: Dion Boucicault's comedy 'London ___' has a title word that also means self-confidence

explanation.definitionFit: Assurance means self-confidence, and Boucicault's 1841 comedy is 'London Assurance'.

clue.text: Same old hash from the old girl

indicators.note: making a hash of something means jumbling it, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: The same old mess served up by an elderly woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the old girl' is fair because the answer is an archaic word for a damsel.
explanation.definitionFit: Damosel is an old poetic spelling of damsel, a young woman.

clue.text: Face.. away from personal responsibility

definitions.meaning: to ..., as a window looks out on a view, is to face outwards
'that's your ...' means that is your own concern

explanation.definitionFit: Looking out means facing outward, and 'your lookout' is your own concern or duty.

clue.text: Lower deck holds the record

indicators.note: holds says the word for deck contains the record

parts.note: to deck is to adorn or dress
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: The lower deck of a ship is where the record is kept.
explanation.definitionFit: To depress is to push down, to lower.

clue.text: There's more in the pool here, to intensify greed at the finish

definitions.text: There's more in the pool here

parts.note: to deepen is to intensify

indicators.note: at the finish picks the final letter of greed

explanation.surface: A pool sign, then an urge to make greed worse at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'There's more in the pool here' is cryptic: the water is deepest there.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep end of a swimming pool is where the water is greatest in depth.

clue.text: What the golfer on the green hopes to do, say, — it's healthy

indicators.note: say tells us the phrase is spoken and matched to a word of the same sound

parts.words: What the golfer on the green hopes to do
parts.note: on the green a golfer hopes to hole some putts, read as 'hole some'

explanation.surface: A golfer's hopes on the putting green, with a remark about healthy living.
explanation.definitionFit: Something wholesome is good for you, beneficial to health.

clue.text: Scotch, perhaps — get tight with it

definitions.meaning: a scotch is a block or chock put under a wheel
a block driven in to make something fit tightly

explanation.definitionFit: A scotch is a chock placed under a wheel, and the same block jams things fast.

clue.text: "Out of the came forth meat' (Judges)

definitions.text: Out of the came forth meat

parts.words: Out of the came forth meat
parts.note: Samson's riddle in Judges 14 about the lion, with the word for a devourer left blank

explanation.walkthrough: Samson's riddle: 'Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness'.
explanation.definitionFit: A devourer of food, here the lion in whose carcass bees made honey.

clue.text: One who goes up Linden's river:

parts.note: the Iser is the river at Hohenlinden in Thomas Campbell's poem 'Hohenlinden'

explanation.surface: Someone travelling upstream along a German river.
explanation.walkthrough: Campbell's poem 'Hohenlinden' has the line 'And dark as winter was the flow / Of Iser, rolling rapidly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A riser is someone who gets up or ascends, as an early riser does.

clue.text: Old women about in brogues?

indicators.note: about says the word for women goes around the letter for old

parts.note: shes are females, women

explanation.surface: Elderly women wandering about in sturdy footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Brogues are a kind of stout leather footwear, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Sally after old Penny's cow

indicators.note: after places the word for Sally behind the coin's letter

parts.note: D was the abbreviation for a penny in pre-decimal British money
Aunt Sally is a fairground target game, and a figure set up to be knocked down

explanation.surface: A cow belonging to Sally, coming after one owned by an old woman named Penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cow' is a verb here: to intimidate.
explanation.definitionFit: To daunt and to cow both mean to intimidate or dishearten.

clue.text: Scruffy brown vole, past: its prime

indicators.note: scruffy means untidy, so these letters are messed about

explanation.surface: An ageing, shabby little rodent.
explanation.definitionFit: Overblown flowers are past full bloom, so beyond their best.

clue.text: Cursed tax decree is changed

indicators.note: is changed signals that the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tax law is altered after everyone damned it.
explanation.definitionFit: To execrate is to curse or denounce, so execrated means cursed.

clue.text: One in besides a girl

indicators.note: in puts the numeral for one inside the word for besides

parts.note: else means besides or in addition
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: One more girl in addition to the others.
explanation.definitionFit: Elsie is a woman's given name.
